I fixed the memory record: the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at Gate 47, not Dock 23.

- **Old note:** I withdrew the Dock 23 entry. The reason I logged is Pree's correction that she read the wrong line.
- **New note:** I saved Gate 47 as the site, with a pointer to her correction post in #central-team.
- **Reply:** I answered in her thread to say the record is fixed. She said no action was needed, so I did nothing else.

Before the change, Dock 23 was the only fact saved about Marrow Agrisupply. The memory can't catch the same fact worded differently, so I can't rule out a copy saved under other wording.
